notes: Nevada has no personal income tax on wages or self-employment income (Nevada Department of Taxation, 'Income Tax in Nevada').
The Modified Business Tax applies only to employers' taxable wages; a sole proprietor or single-member LLC with no employees does not owe it. Not modeled.

seDeduction.note: Not applicable: Nevada has no individual income tax.

seHealthInsurance.note: Not applicable: Nevada has no individual income tax.

retirementContributions.note: Not applicable: Nevada has no individual income tax.

qbi.note: Not applicable: Nevada has no individual income tax.

localIncomeTax.note: No city or county income taxes in Nevada.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $425 total at formation: $75 Articles of Organization + $150 Initial List of Managers or Members + $200 State Business License (Nevada Secretary of State).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $350 per year: $150 Annual List of Managers or Members + $200 State Business License renewal (late fees: $75 list, $100 license).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None. The $200 State Business License fee is required even for single-member LLCs; sole proprietors without an LLC generally also need a $200 state business license unless exempt.
businessCosts.grossReceiptsTax: Commerce Tax applies only if Nevada gross revenue in a fiscal year (July-June) exceeds $4,000,000; the first $4,000,000 is deducted and rates vary by industry. A typical freelancer is below the threshold and has no filing requirement.
